people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Carmel
people.line: Town in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languishes.
translations.bsb: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the flower of Lebanon wilts.
translations.kjv: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
translations.asv: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, and drieth up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
